title: borreria poaya
intro: Borreria poaya, commonly known as the West African shrub, is a plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate pain, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Borreria poaya include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential applications of Borreria poaya in modern medicine.
